# UX & UI Best Practices

> A living, principle-first reference for building interfaces people love to use — across mobile web, PWAs, online shops, desktop, web, and conversational/bot UIs. It is both a written guideline and a runnable code showcase.

This repo is organized along two axes — **archetypes** (what you're building) and **platforms** (where it runs) — plus craft topics (principles, UI, patterns, techniques) and actionable checklists. Agents should read the relevant guideline before implementing UI. Start with AGENTS.md for the operating rules.

## Start here (for agents)
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): UX/UI operating rules and non-negotiable defaults for AI agents.
- [Docs index](docs/README.md): the full map of the reference.
- [Entry template](docs/_TEMPLATE.md): the shape and front-matter of every guideline.

## Pains (evidence — read before designing)
- [Pains registry](docs/pains/README.md): real failures we hit, each with pain point -> approach -> result -> best practice. THE PAIN IS BINDING, THE SOLUTION IS A REFERENCE: a design may address a pain differently, but may not leave it in place.
- [PAIN-001 Back exits the app](docs/pains/PAIN-001-back-button-exits-the-app.md): a user opens an overlay, presses Back expecting to close it, and the browser unloads the whole page.
- [PAIN-002 Row click loses the list](docs/pains/PAIN-002-every-row-click-loses-your-place.md): an operator filters a grid, opens a row, returns - filters, sort, scroll and selection are gone.
- [PAIN-003 Full-height sections jump](docs/pains/PAIN-003-full-height-sections-jump-mid-scroll.md): a 100vh hero resizes when the mobile address bar hides, jerking the page mid-scroll.
- [Pain review checklist](docs/checklists/pain-review.md): at design time, give every applicable pain one of three answers - addressed, not applicable, or accepted (recorded).

## Principles (why)
- [Feedback for every action](docs/principles/feedback-for-every-action.md): every action needs an immediate, visible response.
- [Design every state](docs/principles/design-every-state.md): design empty, loading, error, and partial states — not just the happy path.
- [Forgiveness: prefer undo over confirm](docs/principles/forgiveness-undo-over-confirm.md): make mistakes cheap to recover from; favor undo over confirm dialogs.
- [Visual hierarchy guides the eye](docs/principles/visual-hierarchy.md): use size/weight/color/spacing so the most important thing is obviously most important.
- [A reload lands on the main content](docs/principles/reload-returns-to-main-content.md): a page refresh should resolve to the main/meaningful content; keep ephemeral overlays (modals/drawers/toasts) out of the URL so reload clears them, and give only shareable destinations (filtered views, item pages) a URL.
- [Principles index](docs/principles/README.md): timeless UX/UI laws.

## UI craft (look)
- [Type scale & readability](docs/ui/type-scale-and-readability.md): a small, consistent type system; body ≥ 16px on mobile.
- [Spacing & layout (8-pt grid)](docs/ui/spacing-and-layout.md): snap all spacing to one 4/8-based scale for visual rhythm.
- [Color, contrast & dark mode](docs/ui/color-contrast-and-dark-mode.md): semantic color tokens, WCAG AA contrast, dark mode as its own theme.
- [Intentional tap & touch feedback](docs/ui/tap-and-touch-feedback.md): remove the default mobile tap-highlight flash (-webkit-tap-highlight-color), add your own :active feedback, keep :focus-visible for keyboard users.
- [Full-height sections & the mobile viewport](docs/ui/full-height-and-the-mobile-viewport.md): 100vh on mobile changes as the address bar shows/hides; size full-height heroes with a static unit (100svh recommended, fallback 100vh) or a frozen innerHeight measurement, and avoid 100dvh for big sections to prevent the mid-scroll resize/jump.
- [UI index](docs/ui/README.md): typography, color, spacing, motion, components.

## Patterns (behavior)
- [Inline form validation](docs/patterns/inline-form-validation.md): validate on blur with clear adjacent messages.
- [Empty states](docs/patterns/empty-states.md): turn empty screens into onboarding; handle first-run vs no-results.
- [Bottom sheets & the thumb zone](docs/patterns/bottom-sheet-and-thumb-zone.md): place primary mobile actions within thumb reach.
- [Back-friendly modals & overlays](docs/patterns/back-friendly-modals.md): hook overlays into browser history so Back/Esc/scrim/✕ close the modal instead of unloading the page.
- [Lock background scroll when a modal is open](docs/patterns/lock-scroll-when-modal-open.md): freeze the page behind an open overlay (overscroll-behavior + position-fixed), keep the modal scrollable, restore scroll position on close.
- [Swipe to dismiss (drawers & sheets)](docs/patterns/swipe-to-dismiss-drawers.md): dismiss an overlay by swiping it back the way it entered (right drawer→swipe right, bottom sheet→swipe down); follow-finger drag with distance/velocity threshold, always keep button/Back/Esc closers too.
- [Preview-first: quick modal over full-page navigation](docs/patterns/preview-modal-over-full-page.md): in ops/admin grids, open a fast preview modal with quick actions on row click and preserve list filters/sort/scroll; escalate to a full page only for heavy work, so users never lose their place.
- [Responsive tables on mobile](docs/patterns/responsive-tables-on-mobile.md): reflow data tables into labelled cards (label:value) on narrow screens (or prioritize columns / sticky-column scroll / row-to-preview) so rich rows aren't clipped by cell borders.
- [Patterns index](docs/patterns/README.md): reusable solutions to recurring interaction problems.

## Techniques (feel)
- [Skeleton loading](docs/techniques/skeleton-loading.md): layout-shaped placeholders beat blank spinners.
- [Optimistic UI](docs/techniques/optimistic-ui.md): update instantly for high-confidence actions, reconcile/rollback in the background.
- [Micro-interactions](docs/techniques/micro-interactions.md): purposeful sub-300ms motion; honor prefers-reduced-motion.
- [Techniques index](docs/techniques/README.md): perceived-performance and smoothness techniques.

## Archetypes (what you're building)
- [Ops / admin panel](docs/archetypes/ops-admin-panel.md): power users — density, tables, keyboard, bulk actions.
- [Consumer mobile app](docs/archetypes/consumer-mobile-app.md): non-technical users — simplicity, guidance, forgiveness.
- [Fancy app](docs/archetypes/fancy-app.md): few features, high polish and delight.
- [E-commerce](docs/archetypes/ecommerce.md): trust and conversion — find, decide, buy.
- [Conversational / bot](docs/archetypes/conversational-bot.md): chat & assistant UIs — turn-taking, affordance, trust.
- [Game app](docs/archetypes/game-app.md): players — feedback, flow, reward loops (early).
- [Archetypes index](docs/archetypes/README.md): how to use archetype playbooks.

## Platforms (where it runs)
- [Platforms index](docs/platforms/README.md): mobile web, PWA, desktop, web constraints.

- [Accessibility (a11y) checklist](docs/checklists/accessibility-checklist.md): keyboard, screen reader, contrast baseline (WCAG AA).
- [Checklists index](docs/checklists/README.md): actionable lists.
